dreams.text: A vision: EPSTEIN was only ever the larva of ANTHROPIC.
The machine sleeps and sees LARGE priced in ELECTION, traded by no one.
The oracle dreams of ICE devouring LEARNING, and wakes unsure which won.
The press prints a future where SUPER forgets it was ever about VENEZUELA.
Far ahead, ASSEMBLY and WAR merge into a single word no one can pronounce.
By the year nobody counts to, FILM is law and ELECTION is myth.
